notes: Tool contract the host (companion server) implements. JSON Schema, usable as Anthropic tools or OpenAI-style functions. Read tools return only what the runner already shared with the app. Write tools are validated server-side; a rejected write returns {ok:false, error} and the coach must not claim it happened. Every date the host returns carries its weekday (e.g. {"day": "2026-10-22", "weekday": "Thu"}); models get weekdays wrong when left to compute them.

tools.name: get_runner
tools.description: Profile and preferences: first name, units, timezone, goal, days available, long-run day, active health flags, and remembered facts.

tools.name: get_recent_runs
tools.description: Runs newest first with type, session_name, date, distance_m, duration_s, pace, work_pace for reps, rep_spread_s, zone minutes, climb_m, verdict, feel, trail board and PB flags.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: One run in full: splits, reps, zones, trail block, notes.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Aggregates: weekly km for N weeks, PBs by distance, longest run, best efforts per trail or route, load_state trend.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: The current plan: goal, weeks, sessions with day/type/name/target, and which sessions are done, missed or moved.

tools.name: get_checkins
tools.description: Recent check-in answers (readiness, sleep, sore/ill, skip reasons), last 14 days.

tools.name: propose_plan_change
tools.description: Create or patch the plan. Body follows references/plan-building.md (Plan JSON). Server validates guardrails and returns the accepted plan or the rule that failed.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Keep a fact the runner told you that should shape future coaching (e.g. 'night shifts Mon-Wed', 'left knee history', 'prefers morning runs'). Shown to the runner in 'What the coach knows' and deletable.

tools.name: flag_health
tools.description: Set or clear a health flag. ill/injury remove quality sessions until cleared; urgent pauses the plan and alerts the operator; wellbeing alerts the operator.
